text.raster_limit: Visible glyph and punctuation classes are transcribed; raster inspection does not certify source Unicode code points.

style.observations: No visible color accent or sepia; quiet object photographs and direct black typography.

substantive_non_glyph.observations: Two large lever and inserted-key photographs occupy approximately 63% of height and communicate functional hardware subjects.

layout_fidelity.observations: Central seven-copy white area retained between independent upper and lower close photographs, with no tiny footer or added labels.

hangul.observations: Open counters, natural square proportions and clear word spacing at native and usage720.

function_contact.observations: Lever mount/rotation attachment, grasping length, lower cylinder and continuous key insertion visible. The contact-wear interpretation remains weakened by pervasive pattern.

local_material_edge_finish.observations: Narrow key rim reflection and broad lever highlight retained; loops in key center are more conspicuous than repair-1.

located_observations.observation: Broad diffuse reflection and intact object outline retained. A fine pervasive wavy pattern remains on front, neck and mounting rosette.
Bright rim retained but center has larger loop-like etched texture than repair-1, rather than the requested quiet plain satin field.
Cylinder face, slot and continuous inserted neck remain recognizable; no obvious floating gap appears.
All seven copy entries are readable, with title/subtitle, date/venue, hours/free admission and URL grouped; observed normalized comparisons retain all glyphs, words and visible punctuation classes.
Syllable proportions, counters and word boundaries remain coherent; no visible extra labels or printed numbers beyond supplied copy.
Two large photographic objects and the central title remain dominant; no hue or unrelated ornament appears.

residuals.observation: Wavy etched-looking loops remain over the whole key head; compared with repair-1 their larger individual shapes are more conspicuous.
residuals.impact: The requested plain satin center and narrow localized finger polish have not been fully achieved.

residuals.location: Upper lever grip, protected neck, upper rosette
residuals.observation: Broad front highlight is smooth at usage size, but repeated small wavy scratches are still visible at native size across protected and touched parts.
residuals.impact: Smooth contact wear is not sufficiently distinct from the overall surface finish.

residuals.observation: Title and both objects remain recognizable, while the smallest details read more comfortably at usage720 than thumbnail size.
residuals.impact: Legibility was checked for the supplied QA scales, with no print test or arbitrary-size guarantee.
